description: This file defines middleware functions for security and request handling in a Node.js/Express backend, including CORS configuration, helmet security headers, and rate limiting.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for handling CORS with a dynamic whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware using Helmet with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express rate limiting middleware with configurable window and max requests, skipping GET requests by default.
